caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular piece of aged, tan paper decorated with floral and heart motifs. At the center is a large, cream-colored heart outlined with a patterned border of red and blue triangles and green elements. Inside the heart, there is German-language calligraphy written in black ink. To the left and right of the main heart, there are two symmetrical floral arrangements, each with tall, red, tulip-like flowers with blue accents, and leafy, curving stems; smaller flowers in teal, red, and yellow are interspersed among the leaves. Beneath the main heart, there are two smaller hearts, each with more black handwritten text inside. The small heart on the left is angled upward to the right, while the small heart on the right is angled upward to the left. The background of the paper has a darker, unevenly stained look, with clear signs of aging and some rough edges. The entire piece is mounted or displayed on a clean white background. The name "CHARLOTTE ANCUS" is typed or printed in small capitals on the lower right of the white background.
title: Pa. German Birth Certificate
